title: Nginx – Reverse proxy, load balancing & caching
titleEn: Nginx – Reverse proxy, load balancing & caching
description: Kiến trúc event-driven của nginx, reverse proxy vs forward proxy, server/location, proxy_pass và dấu gạch chéo cuối, upstream load balancing, TLS termination, HTTP/2, gzip, proxy cache, rate limiting, WebSocket, lỗi cấu hình thường gặp và so sánh với HAProxy, Envoy, cloud LB.
descriptionEn: Nginx's event-driven architecture, reverse vs forward proxy, server/location blocks, proxy_pass and the trailing slash, upstream load balancing, TLS termination, HTTP/2, gzip, proxy caching, rate limiting, WebSockets, common config mistakes, and how it compares with HAProxy, Envoy and cloud load balancers.
